title: ElectroForge Innovations: MGIT's Rising Stars Win Rs 1,00,000 at Founders Fest 2023! - MGIT

## ElectroForge Innovations: MGIT’s Rising Stars Win Rs 1,00,000 at Founders Fest 2023!

News Date : 04 Jan 2024News ReportDate: 4th January  2024Students of Department of ECE & MCT of MGIT – K Venkata Sriram, Anoop Dorepally, Brundha Reddy (MCT), Abhishek Sharma, Jayanth Dharmapuri, Nitish Akula, Pavan Kumar, Deepika Rathod – have initiated a startup named ElectroForge Innovations two months ago.ElectroForge Innovations won a Rs 1,00,000 cash prize as a capital investment at Founders Fest 2023: The Great Hyderabad Business Challenge organized by EdVenture Park on December 31 and January 1. The prize was presented by Mr. Ajit Rangnekar, Former Dean of the Indian School of Business. During the event, Mr. Jayesh Ranjan, IAS, Mr. VC Sajjanar, MD of TSRTC & Ex-ADGP of Telangana State, and Mr. M Srinivas Rao, CEO of T Hub interacted with the students, providing support and insights.

Date: 4th January  2024
Students of Department of ECE & MCT of MGIT – K Venkata Sriram, Anoop Dorepally, Brundha Reddy (MCT), Abhishek Sharma, Jayanth Dharmapuri, Nitish Akula, Pavan Kumar, Deepika Rathod – have initiated a startup named ElectroForge Innovations two months ago.
ElectroForge Innovations won a Rs 1,00,000 cash prize as a capital investment at Founders Fest 2023: The Great Hyderabad Business Challenge organized by EdVenture Park on December 31 and January 1. The prize was presented by Mr. Ajit Rangnekar, Former Dean of the Indian School of Business. During the event, Mr. Jayesh Ranjan, IAS, Mr. VC Sajjanar, MD of TSRTC & Ex-ADGP of Telangana State, and Mr. M Srinivas Rao, CEO of T Hub interacted with the students, providing support and insights.
